purpose: Re-adjudicate Yanagi submarine route survival, passenger/cargo substitution, and information-vs-physical-technology gates under Branch COMSEC, navigation, trim/stowage and submarine-operability changes. Only events on or before 1944-01-28 may be realized here; later arrivals are conditional projections.
authority_note: CURRENT authority remains 1944-01-01. This file supersedes prior WORKING ambiguity only for Yanagi route/technology-gate interpretation through 1944-01-28.
core_rules: Remove historical kills whose essential enabling condition was decrypted high-grade Axis/Japanese traffic when that traffic is protected by Branch COMSEC; do not remove ordinary ASW, mine, weather, machinery or navigation risk.
Survival of one mission changes the cargo and questions of the next mission; do not copy historical duplicate cargo manifests after an earlier Branch delivery succeeded.
Separate secure textual/people/paper information gates from bulky physical-hardware gates. A submarine need not reach Kure for every piece of information to reach Japan.
A route divergence is propagated into timing, passenger allocation, stowage/trim and Allied interception opportunity; historical dates after the divergence remain trace anchors, not automatic events.
No future Yanagi success is guaranteed. Only the I-34 historical Taurus gate is adjudicated through 1944-01-28; Europe arrival and return remain future gates.

realized_branch_chain_through_1944_01_28.historical_problem: After reaching Singapore, historical I-30 hit a British mine; the complete Wuerzburg set and much of the remaining cargo were lost/damaged, although ten T-Enigma machines had already been offloaded.
realized_branch_chain_through_1944_01_28.branch_effect: Late-1942 Japan receives complete physical radar/ESM/acoustic-deception/metrology/torpedo-comparison cargo instead of damaged salvage. T-Enigma bilateral-liaison existence is not counted wholly as an I-30-survival bonus because ten machines historically reached Singapore before the loss; survival instead preserves the rest of the coding sets, spares, training continuity and especially the non-offloaded technical hardware.
realized_branch_chain_through_1944_01_28.downstream_manifest_effect: The Apr-1943 U-180/I-29 exchange becomes second-pass documentation, small parts, tolerances and answers to Japanese measurement questions rather than a first replacement of the lost I-30 package.

realized_branch_chain_through_1944_01_28.branch_effect: Second-pass implementation data can be selected against Japanese late-1942/early-1943 bench findings. This is refinement, not a duplicate technology multiplier.
Comparative Type-IX reference for welding, machinery mounting, vibration/noise, maintenance access and measurement. Does not create SenTaka and does not retroactively redesign Ko-1..6.

21 Dec 1943 return adds tacit fault-diagnosis/calibration/acoustic-test knowledge to hardware already studied for roughly a year. By 28 Jan 1944 procedures can begin moving into research yards and selected A-grade field-service nodes; no mass new hardware is credited.

realized_branch_chain_through_1944_01_28.historical_problem: Cargo loading in Singapore upset trim, delayed departure about a week, sent passengers by train toward Penang, and placed I-34 in a 13 Nov Ultra-directed HMS Taurus ambush.
causal_basis: Branch high-grade COMSEC removes the specific Ultra vector that made HMS Taurus wait for I-34.

After the successful I-30 and established Yanagi procedures, cargo partitioning, fixed racks, weight-specific stowage diagrams and fuel-burn trim tables reduce the chance that the same cargo produces the same full one-week delay.
This does not eliminate ordinary trim risk or Malacca/Indian-Ocean/Atlantic ASW risk.
realized_branch_chain_through_1944_01_28.working_departure_band: Singapore/Seletar 1943-11-07..10, center 1943-11-08/09; exact hour not fixed
realized_branch_chain_through_1944_01_28.passenger_consequence: Rear Adm Kojima and the two Mitsubishi engineers are no longer displaced to I-29 by I-34's historical sinking. Centerline keeps the original technical passenger party with I-34; an exact Penang brief stop is not needed for the technology gate and is left non-critical.
realized_branch_chain_through_1944_01_28.why_this_matters: The engineers can inspect German turbojet/rocket/radar/submarine production about a month before historical I-29's 11 Mar Lorient arrival, creating an early technical-observation gate even if no return cargo has yet reached Japan.

realized_branch_chain_through_1944_01_28.historical_problem: Historically inherited many I-34 passengers and was repeatedly located from decrypted traffic; later carried Jumo004B/HWK509A-1 and was sunk after an intercepted Singapore-to-Japan schedule.
realized_branch_chain_through_1944_01_28.branch_state_at_1944_01_28: OUTBOUND_IN_TRANSIT; historical Dec-1943 departure retained but historical passenger list no longer valid
realized_branch_chain_through_1944_01_28.manifest_consequence: Kojima and the original I-34 technical party are not duplicated. Spare berths/cargo margin can be used for complementary specialists, measurement gear or strategic cargo; exact replacement roster is intentionally unresolved.
realized_branch_chain_through_1944_01_28.route_consequence: Allied generic patrol/air risks remain, but high-grade COMINT cueing cannot be copied automatically.
realized_branch_chain_through_1944_01_28.future_return_information_gate: If I-29 reaches Singapore, passengers/blueprints/drawings can move by air to Japan even if the hull later fails to reach Kure.
realized_branch_chain_through_1944_01_28.future_return_physical_gate: Historical high-confidence bulky cargo includes one Jumo 004B and one HWK 509A-1. BMW 003 photographs/general-arrangement information are high-confidence technology inputs, but a complete physical BMW 003 engine is not automatically granted.
realized_branch_chain_through_1944_01_28.post_singapore_survival_policy: Historical Sawfish interception is not inherited because it depended on intercepted/decrypted itinerary traffic. A later Branch route-survival adjudication must still include generic US submarine patrol risk; no auto-success.

future_missions_not_realized.rule: Future. Historical loss was a direct sonar/Hedgehog/depth-charge ASW engagement rather than a clean single COMINT ambush; Branch submarine improvements may help survival but do not erase the event automatically. No Me-163 blueprint benefit credited before its future route gate.
Future. Rebuild mission/cargo only when discussion clock reaches it; prior successful deliveries may change what Germany/Japan choose to send. Do not copy historical manifest or loss automatically.
Future after 28 Jan. Outbound survival through the historical Taurus gate is realized; Europe arrival, technical visit, return cargo and return survival are conditional.
Future after 28 Jan. Do not pre-credit German jet/rocket hardware.

information_gate_model_after_I34_if_futu.gate_A_low_bandwidth_secure_text: After firsthand inspection in Europe, the I-34 party can send concise secure summaries: axial-vs-centrifugal architecture, stage counts/ranges, thrust/mass/diameter class, modular construction, short-life hot-section philosophy, major test failures and priority questions. This can prune Japanese design choices within days/weeks.
not_transmittable_reliably_at_gate_A: detailed tolerances and surface finish maps
information_gate_model_after_I34_if_futu.gate_B_people_paper_small_hardware: A returning submarine can carry microfilm/drawings/test reports/material samples, bearings/seals/fuel-control parts, selected compressor/turbine components and measurement instruments. These can support detailed redesign before a complete engine arrives.
information_gate_model_after_I34_if_futu.gate_C_bulky_physical: Complete Jumo/HWK/large artifacts require a surviving hull or alternate physical transport. This remains a later separate event.

anti_double_count_guards: Do not credit secure Germany-Japan liaison entirely to I-30 survival: some T-Enigmas historically reached Singapore before the mine loss.
Do not credit SenTaka, domestic high-grade COMSEC, Japanese turbojet research or piston fighter programs to Yanagi.
Do not use both 'I-34 engineers arrived early' and 'I-29 historically carried the same engineers' as two independent gains.
Do not assume a full BMW003 engine merely because BMW003 photos/general arrangement can reach Japan.
Do not convert removal of Ultra-directed ambushes into immunity from mines, visual patrols, radar aircraft, hunter-killer groups or mechanical failure.
